INSERT INTO scheduled_tasks (application_id, kind, key, run_at, payload)
                 VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
                 ON CONFLICT (application_id, kind, key) DO UPDATE
                 SET run_at = EXCLUDED.run_at,
                     payload = EXCLUDED.payload,
                     claimed_at = NULL,
                     attempts = 0
